Love this place
May 2018 • Couples
Really different bar from what you usually find in Da Nang. It’s still in the center of the city just down a block or two from the Main Street! It’s definitely worth a visit, the drinks are cheap and the vibes are so good with live music and other themed nights. The owners are two artists and it’s evident from the funky and tasteful artwork all over the inside and outside of the bar. They also do happy hour from 6-8! Give this place a visit if you’re looking for a genuine and cool bar with good vibes! It was the first bar in Vietnam where we got to sit down and talk to people and really enjoyed ourselves!
